19: import java.io.IOException;
20: import java.util.ArrayList;
21: import java.util.Collection;

32: import org.apache.lucene.search.Scorer;

34: import org.apache.lucene.util.Bits;

37: import org.apache.lucene.util.PriorityQueue;
38: 
39: class DrillSidewaysScorer extends BulkScorer {
40: 
41:   private static final Comparator<DocsAndCost> APPROXIMATION_COMPARATOR =
42:       Comparator.comparingLong(e -> e.cost);
43: 
44:   private static final Comparator<DocsAndCost> TWO_PHASE_COMPARATOR =
45:       (a, b) -> Float.compare(a.matchCost, b.matchCost);
46: 
47:   // private static boolean DEBUG = false;
48: 
49:   final Collector drillDownCollector;
50:   LeafCollector drillDownLeafCollector;
51: 
52:   final DocsAndCost[] dims;
53: 
54:   // DrillDown DocsEnums:
55:   final Scorer baseScorer;
56:   final DocIdSetIterator baseIterator;
57:   final DocIdSetIterator baseApproximation;
58:   final TwoPhaseIterator baseTwoPhase;
59:   final long baseCost;
60: 
61:   final LeafReaderContext context;
62: 
63:   final boolean scoreSubDocsAtOnce;
64: 
65:   final DrillSidewaysQuery query;
66: 
67:   private static final int CHUNK = 2048;
68:   private static final int MASK = CHUNK - 1;
69: 
70:   private int collectDocID = -1;
71:   private float collectScore;
72: 
73:   DrillSidewaysScorer(
74:       LeafReaderContext context,
75:       Scorer baseScorer,
76:       Collector drillDownCollector,
77:       DocsAndCost[] dims,
78:       boolean scoreSubDocsAtOnce,
79:       DrillSidewaysQuery query) {
80:     this.dims = dims;
81:     this.context = context;
82:     this.baseScorer = baseScorer;
83:     this.baseIterator = baseScorer.iterator();
84:     this.baseTwoPhase = baseScorer.twoPhaseIterator();
85:     if (baseTwoPhase != null) {
86:       this.baseApproximation = baseTwoPhase.approximation();
87:     } else {
88:       this.baseApproximation = baseIterator;
89:     }
90:     // some scorers, eg ReqExlScorer, can hit NPE if cost is called after nextDoc
91:     this.baseCost = this.baseIterator.cost();
92:     this.drillDownCollector = drillDownCollector;
93:     this.scoreSubDocsAtOnce = scoreSubDocsAtOnce;
94:     this.query = query;
95:   }
96: 
97:   @Override
98:   public long cost() {
99:     return baseIterator.cost();
100:   }
101: 
102:   @Override
103:   public int score(LeafCollector collector, Bits acceptDocs, int min, int maxDoc)
104:       throws IOException {
105:     return query.scoreSideways(this, collector, acceptDocs, min, maxDoc);
106:   }
107: 
108:   /**
109:    * Query-first scoring specialization when there is only one drill-sideways dimension, which is
110:    * likely a common scenario.
111:    */
112:   private void doQueryFirstScoringSingleDim(
113:       Bits acceptDocs, LeafCollector collector, DocsAndCost dim) throws IOException {
114:     int docID = baseApproximation.docID();
115:     while (docID != DocIdSetIterator.NO_MORE_DOCS) {
116:       assert docID == baseApproximation.docID();
117: 
118:       if (acceptDocs != null && acceptDocs.get(docID) == false) {
119:         docID = baseApproximation.nextDoc();
120:         continue;
121:       }
122: 
123:       if (baseTwoPhase != null && baseTwoPhase.matches() == false) {
124:         docID = baseApproximation.nextDoc();
125:         continue;
126:       }
127: 
128:       // We have either a near-miss or full match. Check the sideways dim to see which it is:
129:       collectDocID = docID;
130:       if (advanceIfBehind(docID, dim.approximation) != docID
131:           || (dim.twoPhase != null && dim.twoPhase.matches() == false)) {
132:         // The sideways dim missed, so we have a "near miss":
133:         collectNearMiss(dim.sidewaysLeafCollector);
134:       } else {
135:         // Hit passed all filters, so it's "real":
136:         collectHit(collector, dim);
137:       }
138: 
139:       docID = baseApproximation.nextDoc();
140:     }
141:   }
142: 
143:   /**
144:    * Used when base query is highly constraining vs the drilldowns, or when the docs must be scored
145:    * at once (i.e., like BooleanScorer2, not BooleanScorer).
146:    */
147:   void doQueryFirstScoring(Bits acceptDocs, LeafCollector collector, DocsAndCost[] dims)
148:       throws IOException {
149:     setScorer(collector, ScoreCachingWrappingScorer.wrap(baseScorer));
150: 
151:     // Specialize the single-dim use-case as we have a more efficient implementation for that:
152:     if (dims.length == 1) {
153:       doQueryFirstScoringSingleDim(acceptDocs, collector, dims[0]);
154:       return;
155:     }
156: 
157:     // Sort our sideways dims by approximation cost so we can advance the lower cost ones first:
158:     List<DocsAndCost> sidewaysDims = new ArrayList<>(dims.length);
159:     sidewaysDims.addAll(List.of(dims));
160:     CollectionUtil.timSort(sidewaysDims, APPROXIMATION_COMPARATOR);
161: 
162:     // Maintain (optional) subset of sideways dims that support two-phase iteration, sorted by
163:     // matchCost:
164:     List<DocsAndCost> sidewaysTwoPhaseDims = null;
165:     for (DocsAndCost dim : dims) {
166:       if (dim.twoPhase != null) {
167:         if (sidewaysTwoPhaseDims == null) {
168:           sidewaysTwoPhaseDims = new ArrayList<>();
169:         }
170:         sidewaysTwoPhaseDims.add(dim);
171:       }
172:     }
173:     if (sidewaysTwoPhaseDims != null) {
174:       CollectionUtil.timSort(sidewaysTwoPhaseDims, TWO_PHASE_COMPARATOR);
175:     }
176: 
177:     // We keep track of a "runaway" dimension, which is a previously "near missed" dimension that
178:     // has advanced beyond the docID the rest of the dimensions are positioned on. This functions
179:     // a bit like the "head" queue in WANDScorer's "min should match" implementation. We use a
180:     // single-valued PQ ordered by docID to easily determine the "closest" runaway dim we'll use
181:     // for advancing in the case that multiple dim approximations miss.
182:     PriorityQueue<DocsAndCost> runawayDim =
183:         new PriorityQueue<>(1) {
184:           @Override
185:           protected boolean lessThan(DocsAndCost a, DocsAndCost b) {
186:             return a.approximation.docID() < b.approximation.docID();
187:           }
188:         };
189: 
190:     int docID = baseApproximation.docID();
191: 
192:     nextDoc:
193:     while (docID != DocIdSetIterator.NO_MORE_DOCS) {
194:       assert docID == baseApproximation.docID();
195: 
196:       if (acceptDocs != null && acceptDocs.get(docID) == false) {
197:         docID = baseApproximation.nextDoc();
198:         continue;
199:       }
200: 
201:       // If we carried a "runaway" over from the last iteration, see if we've "caught up" yet:
202:       DocsAndCost runaway = runawayDim.top();
203:       if (runaway != null && runaway.approximation.docID() <= docID) {
204:         runawayDim.clear();
205:         runaway = null;
206:       }
207: 
208:       // Check the sideways dim approximations. At most, one dim is allowed to miss for the doc
209:       // to be a near-miss or full match. If multiple sideways dims miss, we move on:
210:       for (DocsAndCost dim : sidewaysDims) {
211:         int dimDocID = advanceIfBehind(docID, dim.approximation);
212:         if (dimDocID != docID && dim != runaway) {
213:           DocsAndCost evicted = runawayDim.insertWithOverflow(dim);
214:           if (evicted != null) {
215:             // More than one dim has advanced beyond docID, so we jump ahead to the "closer" of
216:             // the two:
217:             int next = evicted.approximation.docID();
218:             docID = baseApproximation.advance(next);
219:             continue nextDoc;
220:           }
221:         }
222:       }
223: 
224:       // At this point, we have an "approximate" near-miss or full match, but we still need
225:       // to confirm two-phase iterators. First, check the base two-phase (it's always required):
226:       if (baseTwoPhase != null && baseTwoPhase.matches() == false) {
227:         docID = baseApproximation.nextDoc();
228:         continue;
229:       }
230: 
231:       // If we have two-phase iterators for our sideways dims, check them now. At most, one
232:       // sideways dim can miss for the doc to be a near-miss or full match. If more than one misses
233:       // we move on:
234:       DocsAndCost failedDim = runawayDim.top();
235:       if (sidewaysTwoPhaseDims != null) {
236:         if (failedDim == null) {
237:           // If all sideways dims matched in their approximation phase, then we can allow one
238:           // second-phase check to fail:
239:           for (DocsAndCost dim : sidewaysTwoPhaseDims) {
240:             assert dim.approximation.docID() == docID;
241:             if (dim.twoPhase.matches() == false) {
242:               if (failedDim != null) {
243:                 // Two second-phase checks have failed, so we move on:
244:                 docID = baseApproximation.nextDoc();
245:                 continue nextDoc;
246:               } else {
247:                 failedDim = dim;
248:               }
249:             }
250:           }
251:         } else {
252:           // If a sideways dim failed the approximate check, then no second-phase checks can fail:
253:           for (DocsAndCost dim : sidewaysTwoPhaseDims) {
254:             if (failedDim == dim) {
255:               continue;
256:             }
257:             assert dim.approximation.docID() == docID;
258:             if (dim.twoPhase.matches() == false) {
259:               docID = baseApproximation.nextDoc();
260:               continue nextDoc;
261:             }
262:           }
263:         }
264:       }
265: 
266:       collectDocID = docID;
267:       if (failedDim == null) {
268:         // Hit passed all filters, so it's "real":
269:         collectHit(collector, sidewaysDims);
270:       } else {
271:         // Hit missed exactly one dim:
272:         collectNearMiss(failedDim.sidewaysLeafCollector);
273:       }
274: 
275:       docID = baseApproximation.nextDoc();
276:     }
277:   }
278: 
279:   private static int advanceIfBehind(int docID, DocIdSetIterator iterator) throws IOException {
280:     if (iterator.docID() < docID) {
281:       return iterator.advance(docID);
282:     } else {
283:       return iterator.docID();
284:     }
285:   }
286: 
287:   /** Used when drill downs are highly constraining vs baseQuery. */
288:   void doDrillDownAdvanceScoring(
289:       Bits acceptDocs, LeafCollector collector, DocsAndCost[] dims) throws IOException {
290:     setScorer(collector, new ScoreAndDoc());
291: 
292:     final int maxDoc = context.reader().maxDoc();
293:     final int numDims = dims.length;
294: 
295:     // if (DEBUG) {
296:     //  System.out.println("  doDrillDownAdvanceScoring");
297:     // }
298: 
299:     // TODO: maybe a class like BS, instead of parallel arrays
300:     int[] filledSlots = new int[CHUNK];
301:     int[] docIDs = new int[CHUNK];
302:     float[] scores = new float[CHUNK];
303:     int[] missingDims = new int[CHUNK];
304:     int[] counts = new int[CHUNK];
305: 
306:     docIDs[0] = -1;
307:     int nextChunkStart = CHUNK;
308: 
309:     final FixedBitSet seen = new FixedBitSet(CHUNK);
310: 
311:     while (true) {
312:       // if (DEBUG) {
313:       //  System.out.println("\ncycle nextChunkStart=" + nextChunkStart + " docIds[0]=" +
314:       // docIDs[0]);
315:       // }
316: 
317:       // First dim:
318:       // if (DEBUG) {
319:       //  System.out.println("  dim0");
320:       // }
321:       DocsAndCost dc = dims[0];
322:       int docID = dc.approximation.docID();
323:       while (docID < nextChunkStart) {
324:         if (acceptDocs == null || acceptDocs.get(docID)) {
325:           int slot = docID & MASK;
326: 
327:           if (docIDs[slot] != docID && (dc.twoPhase == null || dc.twoPhase.matches())) {
328:             seen.set(slot);
329:             // Mark slot as valid:
330:             // if (DEBUG) {
331:             //  System.out.println("    set docID=" + docID + " id=" +
332:             // context.reader().document(docID).get("id"));
333:             // }
334:             docIDs[slot] = docID;
335:             missingDims[slot] = 1;
336:             counts[slot] = 1;
337:           }
338:         }
339: 
340:         docID = dc.approximation.nextDoc();
341:       }
342: 
343:       // Second dim:
344:       // if (DEBUG) {
345:       //  System.out.println("  dim1");
346:       // }
347:       dc = dims[1];
348:       docID = dc.approximation.docID();
349:       while (docID < nextChunkStart) {
350:         if (acceptDocs == null
351:             || acceptDocs.get(docID) && (dc.twoPhase == null || dc.twoPhase.matches())) {
352:           int slot = docID & MASK;
353: 
354:           if (docIDs[slot] != docID) {
355:             // Mark slot as valid:
356:             seen.set(slot);
357:             // if (DEBUG) {
358:             //  System.out.println("    set docID=" + docID + " missingDim=0 id=" +
359:             // context.reader().document(docID).get("id"));
360:             // }
361:             docIDs[slot] = docID;
362:             missingDims[slot] = 0;
363:             counts[slot] = 1;
364:           } else {
365:             // TODO: single-valued dims will always be true
366:             // below; we could somehow specialize
367:             if (missingDims[slot] >= 1) {
368:               missingDims[slot] = 2;
369:               counts[slot] = 2;
370:               // if (DEBUG) {
371:               //  System.out.println("    set docID=" + docID + " missingDim=2 id=" +
372:               // context.reader().document(docID).get("id"));
373:               // }
374:             } else {
375:               counts[slot] = 1;
376:               // if (DEBUG) {
377:               //  System.out.println("    set docID=" + docID + " missingDim=" + missingDims[slot] +
378:               // " id=" + context.reader().document(docID).get("id"));
379:               // }
380:             }
381:           }
382:         }
383: 
384:         docID = dc.approximation.nextDoc();
385:       }
386: 
387:       // After this we can "upgrade" to conjunction, because
388:       // any doc not seen by either dim 0 or dim 1 cannot be
389:       // a hit or a near miss:
390: 
391:       // if (DEBUG) {
392:       //  System.out.println("  baseScorer");
393:       // }
394: 
395:       // Fold in baseScorer, using advance:
396:       int filledCount = 0;
397:       int slot0 = 0;
398:       while (slot0 < CHUNK && (slot0 = seen.nextSetBit(slot0)) != DocIdSetIterator.NO_MORE_DOCS) {
399:         int ddDocID = docIDs[slot0];
400:         assert ddDocID != -1;
401: 
402:         int baseDocID = baseIterator.docID();
403:         if (baseDocID < ddDocID) {
404:           baseDocID = baseIterator.advance(ddDocID);
405:         }
406:         if (baseDocID == ddDocID) {
407:           // if (DEBUG) {
408:           //  System.out.println("    keep docID=" + ddDocID + " id=" +
409:           // context.reader().document(ddDocID).get("id"));
410:           // }
411:           scores[slot0] = baseScorer.score();
412:           filledSlots[filledCount++] = slot0;
413:           counts[slot0]++;
414:         } else {
415:           // if (DEBUG) {
416:           //  System.out.println("    no docID=" + ddDocID + " id=" +
417:           // context.reader().document(ddDocID).get("id"));
418:           // }
419:           docIDs[slot0] = -1;
420: 
421:           // TODO: we could jump slot0 forward to the
422:           // baseDocID ... but we'd need to set docIDs for
423:           // intervening slots to -1
424:         }
425:         slot0++;
426:       }
427:       seen.clear(0, CHUNK);
428: 
429:       if (filledCount == 0) {
430:         if (nextChunkStart >= maxDoc) {
431:           break;
432:         }
433:         nextChunkStart += CHUNK;
434:         continue;
435:       }
436: 
437:       // TODO: factor this out & share w/ union scorer,
438:       // except we start from dim=2 instead:
439:       for (int dim = 2; dim < numDims; dim++) {
440:         // if (DEBUG) {
441:         //  System.out.println("  dim=" + dim + " [" + dims[dim].dim + "]");
442:         // }
443:         dc = dims[dim];
444:         docID = dc.approximation.docID();
445:         while (docID < nextChunkStart) {
446:           int slot = docID & MASK;
447:           if (docIDs[slot] == docID
448:               && counts[slot] >= dim
449:               && (dc.twoPhase == null || dc.twoPhase.matches())) {
450:             // TODO: single-valued dims will always be true
451:             // below; we could somehow specialize
452:             if (missingDims[slot] >= dim) {
453:               // if (DEBUG) {
454:               //  System.out.println("    set docID=" + docID + " count=" + (dim+2));
455:               // }
456:               missingDims[slot] = dim + 1;
457:               counts[slot] = dim + 2;
458:             } else {
459:               // if (DEBUG) {
460:               //  System.out.println("    set docID=" + docID + " missing count=" + (dim+1));
461:               // }
462:               counts[slot] = dim + 1;
463:             }
464:           }
465: 
466:           // TODO: sometimes use advance?
467:           docID = dc.approximation.nextDoc();
468:         }
469:       }
470: 
471:       // Collect:
472:       // if (DEBUG) {
473:       //  System.out.println("  now collect: " + filledCount + " hits");
474:       // }
475:       for (int i = 0; i < filledCount; i++) {
476:         int slot = filledSlots[i];
477:         collectDocID = docIDs[slot];
478:         collectScore = scores[slot];
479:         // if (DEBUG) {
480:         //  System.out.println("    docID=" + docIDs[slot] + " count=" + counts[slot]);
481:         // }
482:         if (counts[slot] == 1 + numDims) {
483:           collectHit(collector, dims);
484:         } else if (counts[slot] == numDims) {
485:           collectNearMiss(dims[missingDims[slot]].sidewaysLeafCollector);
486:         }
487:       }
488: 
489:       if (nextChunkStart >= maxDoc) {
490:         break;
491:       }
492: 
493:       nextChunkStart += CHUNK;
494:     }
495:   }

497:   void doUnionScoring(Bits acceptDocs, LeafCollector collector, DocsAndCost[] dims)
498:       throws IOException {
499:     // if (DEBUG) {
500:     //  System.out.println("  doUnionScoring");
501:     // }
502:     setScorer(collector, new ScoreAndDoc());
503: 
504:     final int maxDoc = context.reader().maxDoc();
505:     final int numDims = dims.length;
506: 
507:     // TODO: maybe a class like BS, instead of parallel arrays
508:     int[] filledSlots = new int[CHUNK];
509:     int[] docIDs = new int[CHUNK];
510:     float[] scores = new float[CHUNK];
511:     int[] missingDims = new int[CHUNK];
512:     int[] counts = new int[CHUNK];
513: 
514:     docIDs[0] = -1;
515: 
516:     // NOTE: this is basically a specialized version of
517:     // BooleanScorer, to the minShouldMatch=N-1 case, but
518:     // carefully tracking which dimension failed to match
519: 
520:     int nextChunkStart = CHUNK;
521: 
522:     while (true) {
523:       // if (DEBUG) {
524:       //  System.out.println("\ncycle nextChunkStart=" + nextChunkStart + " docIds[0]=" +
525:       // docIDs[0]);
526:       // }
527:       int filledCount = 0;
528:       int docID = baseIterator.docID();
529:       // if (DEBUG) {
530:       //  System.out.println("  base docID=" + docID);
531:       // }
532:       while (docID < nextChunkStart) {
533:         if (acceptDocs == null || acceptDocs.get(docID)) {
534:           int slot = docID & MASK;
535:           // if (DEBUG) {
536:           //  System.out.println("    docIDs[slot=" + slot + "]=" + docID + " id=" +
537:           // context.reader().document(docID).get("id"));
538:           // }
539: 
540:           // Mark slot as valid:
541:           assert docIDs[slot] != docID : "slot=" + slot + " docID=" + docID;
542:           docIDs[slot] = docID;
543:           scores[slot] = baseScorer.score();
544:           filledSlots[filledCount++] = slot;
545:           missingDims[slot] = 0;
546:           counts[slot] = 1;
547:         }

549:       }

552:         if (nextChunkStart >= maxDoc) {

561:       // if (DEBUG) {

563:       // }
564:       {
565:         DocsAndCost dc = dims[0];
566:         docID = dc.approximation.docID();

568:         //  System.out.println("    start docID=" + docID);

572:           if (docIDs[slot] == docID // this also checks that the doc is not deleted
573:               && (dc.twoPhase == null || dc.twoPhase.matches())) {
574:             // if (DEBUG) {

576:             // }
577:             missingDims[slot] = 1;
578:             counts[slot] = 2;
579:           }
580:           docID = dc.approximation.nextDoc();
581:         }
582:       }
583: 
584:       for (int dim = 1; dim < numDims; dim++) {
585:         // if (DEBUG) {
586:         //  System.out.println("  dim=" + dim + " [" + dims[dim].dim + "]");
587:         // }
588: 
589:         DocsAndCost dc = dims[dim];
590:         docID = dc.approximation.docID();
591:         // if (DEBUG) {
592:         //  System.out.println("    start docID=" + docID);
